source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.6 (Blessing 2.0, docs/design/blessing-2.0-spec.md) and 1.6.1 (Faith 2.1, docs/design/faith-2.1-spec.md; section 14 items 701-723) and 1.6.3 (Faith 2.2, docs/design/faith-presence-spec.md; items 738-746) and 1.22 (Faith, round 2: docs/design/handoffs/faith-round-2.md; items 1280-1296) + Narrator's World Bible

cooldown_rule.text: The wait between Hymns is 9 rounds − 0.75 × Faith − 0.25 × Virtue, rounded up, and never under 3. A vow fulfilled in the fight takes 1 round off the wait, once for each Hymn, never under 2 rounds.

intervention.text: While you are Witnessed, your patron acts on its own when its trigger happens, and then Witnessed ends. It can happen once a fight, or twice from Devotion 7. Its damage is 20 + 4 × your Devotion, × your Blessing power; Mother Ember's healing is 10 + 3 × your Devotion, × your Blessing power.

tags.name: Protect
tags.text: Shield an ally, Interpose, Brace, or take a hit meant for someone else.

tags.name: Heal
tags.text: Heal or stabilise someone other than yourself.

tags.name: Mercy
tags.text: Accept a surrender, or end a fight without killing an enemy who surrendered.

tags.name: Judge
tags.text: Kill or Down an enemy that harmed a surrendered or Downed creature this fight.

tags.name: Burn
tags.text: Deal fire damage or set someone Burning.

tags.name: Storm
tags.text: Deal lightning damage: the Sigil word SHOCK, the Storm tone, or any other lightning.

tags.name: Trick
tags.text: Use a Trickster move, hide, make a False Image, feint or swap places.

tags.name: Supply
tags.text: Reload an ally's weapon, throw a stim, hand over an item or place cover.

tags.name: Hold
tags.text: End your turn Braced, Anchored or on Overwatch.

tags.name: Flee
tags.text: Retreat from a fight, or Disengage away from enemies.

tags.name: Desecrate
tags.text: Damage a shrine, a corpse or holy ground.

tags.name: Betray
tags.text: Attack someone on your own side.

tags.name: Cower
tags.text: End your turn Hidden while an ally is Downed.

whispers.name: Luck
whispers.text: You or an ally you can see gets +2 on their next attack roll or check.

whispers.name: Health
whispers.text: You or an ally you can see heals 2.5 × your Blessing power. The heal grows with your level, like all healing and shields from prayer.

whispers.name: Protection
whispers.text: You or an ally you can see gains a shield of 3 × your Blessing power. The shield grows with your level, like all healing and shields from prayer.

whispers.name: Courage
whispers.text: Ends Fear and Shaken on you or an ally you can see.

whispers.name: Guidance
whispers.text: Reveals Hidden enemies and traps within 6 tiles of you, and gives you +2 on your next roll to spot something.

whispers.name: Safe Passage
whispers.text: Your next move this turn provokes no opportunity attacks.

whispers.name: Rebuke
whispers.text: An enemy you can see takes 7 Soul damage × your Blessing power. There is no roll, and armour doesn't lower it.

vows.name: Shield
vows.broken_when: the ally you named is Downed
vows.fulfilled_when: an enemy attacks the ally you named, and when that enemy's turn ends the ally is still standing

vows.name: Mercy
vows.broken_when: you damage a surrendered or Downed enemy
vows.fulfilled_when: an enemy yields to you, or you spare one with a blow that would have killed it

vows.name: Stand
vows.broken_when: you end a turn further from the nearest enemy than you started it
vows.fulfilled_when: an enemy has attacked you since your last turn, and you end your turn no further from the nearest enemy

vows.name: Bare Hands
vows.broken_when: you attack with a gun or a spell
vows.fulfilled_when: an enemy falls to your melee attack

vows.name: No Magic but Theirs
vows.broken_when: you draw a glyph, Evoke a spell or Begin an Outburst
vows.fulfilled_when: an enemy falls to your prayer, or to your patron acting for you

vows.name: Nobody Left Behind
vows.broken_when: an ally is still Downed when the fight ends
vows.fulfilled_when: a Downed ally stands up again because of you

notes: Rules 1.6 (8 Nov 2026). Every number is provisional (spec section 14). Lines are picked by the engine (seeded), never written by the Narrator. Rules 1.20 (the heal and shield pass, 12 Nov 2026): prayer heals and shields were fitted to one Soldier's turn (Health 5, Protection 6, Warm Hands 10, Saint's Shield 12, Absolution 7, Hearthlight 4, Coin for the Ferry 5, Everyone Home's shield 17, Mother Ember's intervention 10 + 3 × Devotion) and grow with the devoted's level (rules.json mending); the engine reads these values. Rules 1.22 (Faith, round 2, 12 Nov 2026): the Whisper is the every-turn prayer and the weakest steady action there is (Rebuke 7, Health 2.5, Protection 3); the Hymn is the set-piece on a cooldown that Faith lowers (prayer.hymn.cooldown_rule) and its numbers are refitted to that (Lightning Rod 110 and 40, Judgement 110, Thunderclap 50, Warm Hands 32, Saint's Shield 38, Absolution 22, Hearthlight 6, Coin for the Ferry 15, Foreknowing 4, Lucky Break 4, Feed the Fire +3 AP); Hold the Gate has a wait of its own (own_cooldown); each vow has a moment that fulfils it in a fight (fulfilled_when).

items.name: Holy Father Nerukhan
items.costume: A stern holy father of the Lumeri saint-church who speaks for the saints; never breaks costume. 'Only the saints may judge.'

grudge.text: Nerukhan names you before the saints: you start every fight Marked, and every other patron hears of it.

accord_terms: Pacts first: answers only those sworn to the Lumeri faith
Keep the costume: never speaks as anything but the Holy Father
The Veil: miracles are always framed as the saints' judgement

rites.name: Confession
rites.text: Confess before the saints. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, outside a fight: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Tithe at a Shrine
rites.text: Leave a share of your loot at a Lumeri shrine. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When an enemy damages a surrendered or Downed creature, that enemy takes 20 + 4 × your Devotion Soul damage, × your Blessing power.

hymns.name: Saint's Shield
hymns.text: You or an ally you can see gains a shield of 38 × your Blessing power. The shield grows with your level.

hymns.name: Judgement
hymns.text: An enemy you can see takes 110 Soul damage × your Blessing power. It takes 30% more if it harmed a surrendered or Downed creature this fight.

hymns.name: Absolution
hymns.text: You or an ally you can see loses every harmful condition and heals 22 × your Blessing power. The heal grows with your level.

miracle.name: The Saints' Verdict
miracle.text: Every enemy in sight takes 130 Soul damage × your Blessing power and is Stunned for 1 round. Enemies that harmed a surrendered or Downed creature this fight take double and are Stunned for 2 rounds.

answered: The saints have heard you, child.
Kneel, then stand. You are answered.
Judgement is theirs. This much is yours.
refused: You reach above your station, child.
The saints do not answer the presumptuous. Ask again, humbler.
taboo: Who made you judge? Not I.
The saints saw that. So did I.
Desecration. I am writing this down.
vow_kept: Your word held. The saints take note.
A vow honoured. Rare, these days.
vow_broken: A broken vow is a broken pot, child.
I heard the oath. I heard it break.
witnessed: The saints are watching. Behave accordingly.
Every eye in the chapel is on you now.
intervention: Only the saints may judge. They have.
Strike the fallen? Not in my sight.
miracle: THE SAINTS HAVE RENDERED THEIR VERDICT.
Let every cruel hand be counted.
conversion: Welcome to the Lumeri faith. Confession is before every battle.
Another soul for the saints. Mind the candles.
farewell: Go, then. The saints keep a list.
You knelt here once, child. Remember it.
I release no one. I only let them walk.
grant: {name}. THE SAINTS HAVE HEARD YOU. I GRANT THEE THIS REQUEST.
KNEEL NO LONGER, {name}. THE SAINTS RISE WITH YOU.
{name}, CHILD OF THE CHAPEL. JUDGEMENT IS GRANTED IN YOUR NAME.

items.source_note: Named in the 2020 material; reading as a Celestial in a pact is from the World Bible. Tenets, rites and blessings are new.

items.name: The Quartermaster
items.costume: The logistics god of a war that never ended: a clerk's visor, a requisition stamp worn on a chain, and a deep love of forms filed in triplicate.
items.archetype: the quartermaster of a war god

grudge.text: Your rations were docked on the way out: you start every fight with Nausea (−1 AP).

accord_terms: Pacts first
Keep the costume
Quotas: asks for bots in kind, so prefers prayers made after a hard fight
tenets: Leave no one on the field

rites.name: Inventory
rites.text: Count and log every round you carry. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, after you have rested this session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Requisition Form
rites.text: File a proper request before you take anything from a depot or a fallen soldier. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When you reload, the reload is free: its AP comes back. When your Evoker's core runs out of charge, a fresh core slots in for free and your spare cores are untouched. When your MP runs out, you get back 25% of your maximum MP, rounded down.

hymns.name: Resupply
hymns.text: You or an ally you can see reloads every weapon for free and regains 1 Supply.

hymns.name: Dig In
hymns.text: You or an ally you can see gains half cover on the tile where they stand, until they move, and is Braced.

hymns.name: Covering Fire
hymns.text: Pick a 3 × 3 area you can see. Each enemy in it is Pinned for 1 round unless it passes a Body save.

miracle.name: Requisition Approved
miracle.text: The whole squad is restocked (ammo, Supplies, throwables) and gets 2 standard cores each. All gear is repaired, jams and heat are cleared, and everyone gets +3 AP next turn.

refused: That form is above your clearance.
Come back with a supervisor's signature.
taboo: Retreat was not on the requisition.
You broke a crate of perfectly good salvage.
That will be deducted from your pay.
vow_kept: Good. That goes on your record.
Exemplary. I may frame this one.
vow_broken: Your vow has been marked VOID.
I had such high hopes for that form.
witnessed: I'm watching the inventory, and you.
intervention: Out of rounds? Not on my watch.
miracle: I have waited a thousand years to stamp this.
conversion: Welcome to the supply corps. Here is your locker key.
farewell: Return your locker key on the way out.
Discharge papers, stamped. Don't lose them.
Transfer approved. Reluctantly.
grant: {name}. REQUISITION RECEIVED, STAMPED AND APPROVED. SIGN HERE.
A REQUEST FROM {name}? IN TRIPLICATE? GRANTED. ALL OF IT.
{name}! YOUR FORM HAS CLEARED EVERY DESK IN HEAVEN. DELIVERING NOW.

items.name: The Laughing Mask
items.costume: The trickster: a grinning mask that never comes off. Joined the Accords to troll them and demands a show.

grudge.text: The Mask leaves something slippery at every curtain-up: you start every fight Prone.

accord_terms: Pacts first
Keep the costume: never removes the mask
The Veil: every miracle must look like luck
tenets: A lie told well is a gift

rites.name: The Opening Act
rites.text: Tell a joke to the room. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, outside a fight: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: A Good Prank
rites.text: Pull a prank that someone important will remember. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When an enemy misses you, it falls Prone.

hymns.name: Lucky Break
hymns.text: Pick yourself or an ally you can see. Their next 4 failed attack rolls are each rerolled at +5. Outside a fight, it is +5 on their next check instead.

hymns.name: Switcheroo
hymns.text: Two creatures you can see, both within 6 tiles of you, swap places. An enemy can resist with a Brain save.

hymns.name: Pratfall
hymns.text: An enemy you can see must pass a Body save or fall Prone and drop the weapon it is holding.

miracle.name: Encore
miracle.text: Every ally may repeat the last action they took this round for free, and every enemy in sight is Confused for 1 round.

taboo: Boring!
Hiding? While your friend bleeds? Boo.
Mercy? In MY show?
vow_kept: You kept it! I'm almost proud.
vow_broken: I knew you would. Everyone knew.
The crowd loved that, mind you.
intervention: Slippery floor. Who put that there?
farewell: Leaving mid-show? Bold.
Exit, stage left! Mind the trapdoor.
Fine. Everyone gets one walk-off.
grant: {name}! OH, YOU WANT A SHOW? THEN LET'S GIVE THEM ONE.
LADIES, GENTLEMEN AND THE SOON-TO-BE-SORRY: {name} HAS ASKED NICELY!
{name}, DARLING, YOU'RE ON. CURTAIN UP!

items.name: The Toll-Keeper
items.domain: The dead, the last crossing, passage paid
items.costume: A quiet Celestial in a boatman's oilskin with a coin box at the hip, who answers at dusk; the guide of the dead at the last crossing.

taboo_notes.kill: only the kill of a surrendered or Downed creature

grudge.text: The river drags at your legs: you start every fight Slowed.

accord_terms: Answers at dusk, or when someone is dying
Never ferries the living
Keeps the coin box closed
tenets: The dying are not to be hurried

rites.name: Vigil
rites.text: Keep a vigil for the dead. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, after you have rested this session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Pay the Toll
rites.text: Put a coin on the eyes of someone who died near you. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When an ally would drop to 0 HP, they stay at 1 HP instead.

hymns.name: Coin for the Ferry
hymns.text: A Downed ally you can see is stabilised and stands up with 15 HP × your Blessing power. The number grows with your level.

hymns.name: Hold the Gate
hymns.text: Until your next turn, you and the allies you can see can't drop below 1 HP. After you pray it, you can't pray Hold the Gate again for 6 rounds; your other Hymns wait as usual.

hymns.name: Last Crossing
hymns.text: An enemy you can see at a quarter of its HP or less must pass a Heart save or die. A boss takes 40 Soul damage × your Blessing power instead.

miracle.name: Turned Back at the Shore
miracle.text: Every ally who died or was Downed this fight stands up at half HP.

answered: The boat waits. Not for you. Not yet.
refused: The water is too high for that.
taboo: You sent one over who had already yielded.
That one was not yours to send.
Leave the dead their rest.
witnessed: I am at the shore. I see you.
miracle: THE SHORE GIVES BACK WHAT IT TOOK.
conversion: You have a seat on the boat now. Not today.
The river knows your name now.
farewell: The river remembers who crossed it.
Keep your coin. You will need it later.
Go. The water is patient.
grant: {name}. THE RIVER HAS HEARD YOU. I WILL ROW AGAINST IT, ONCE.
{name}. YOUR COIN IS GOOD TONIGHT. THE SHORE GIVES WAY.
PUT AWAY YOUR COIN, {name}. THIS CROSSING IS ON ME.

items.name: Mother Ember
items.domain: The hearth, home, the ones who come back
items.costume: The hearth-mother: a kettle always on, an apron, flour on the sleeves; calls everyone 'love'.

grudge.text: Mother Ember isn't angry, only disappointed: you start every fight Shaken.

accord_terms: Answers anyone who is cold or hungry
Never refuses a guest
Keeps the fire lit

rites.name: Share a Meal
rites.text: Give a ration to the squad's table: one food item from your pack. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, outside a fight: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Keep the Fire
rites.text: Keep a fire lit for others through a cold night. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When an ally drops below a quarter of their HP, they heal 10 + 3 × your Devotion, × your Blessing power.

hymns.name: Warm Hands
hymns.text: You or an ally you can see heals 32 × your Blessing power. The heal grows with your level.

hymns.name: Hearthlight
hymns.text: Pick a 3 × 3 area you can see. For 3 rounds, each ally who starts a turn in it heals 6 × your Blessing power. The heal grows with your level.

hymns.name: Feed the Fire
hymns.text: You or an ally you can see gets +3 AP right now, up to the limit of 9 AP, and loses Weakened and Slowed.

miracle.name: Everyone Home
miracle.text: The whole squad heals to full HP, Downed allies stand up, every harmful condition ends, and everyone gains a shield of 17 × your Blessing power. The shield grows with your level.

refused: Ask me again when you've rested.
taboo: We don't turn on our own in this house.
Hiding while they need you? Come out.
I'm not angry. I'm disappointed.
vow_kept: Kept your word. Have a biscuit.
vow_broken: We'll talk about this at home.
witnessed: I can see you from the kitchen.
miracle: Nobody's left out in the cold tonight.
conversion: There's always room at the table.
farewell: Wrap up warm, love. Wherever you're going.
There'll always be a plate for you. Always.
Go on, then. Write.
grant: {name}, LOVE. MOTHER HEARD YOU. COME HERE, ALL OF YOU.
OH, {name}. OF COURSE, LOVE. IT'S ALREADY ON THE STOVE.
{name}! WHO TAUGHT YOU TO ASK SO NICELY? GRANTED, LOVE. GRANTED.

items.name: Old Overcast
items.domain: Thunder, the sky, a good loud entrance
items.costume: The thunder sky-father, played big and theatrical: a beard of cloud, a lightning rod carried like a sceptre. Has a rival Thunder-Father (a future patron).

grudge.text: Old Overcast thunders at your every entrance: you start every fight Dazed.

accord_terms: Answers loudly or not at all
Never shares a storm
Keeps the rival out of his sky

rites.name: Stand in the Storm
rites.text: Bellow a challenge at the sky. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, outside a fight: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Best the Rival
rites.text: Outdo a worshipper of the rival Thunder-Father. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When you kill an enemy, the nearest other enemy takes 20 + 4 × your Devotion lightning damage, × your Blessing power.

hymns.name: Thunderclap
hymns.text: Pick a tile you can see. Each enemy within 2 tiles of it takes 50 lightning damage × your Blessing power, is pushed 1 tile away, and is Shaken unless it passes a Heart save.

hymns.name: Lightning Rod
hymns.text: An enemy you can see takes 110 lightning damage × your Blessing power. It chains to 1 more enemy within 2 tiles for 40 × your Blessing power.

hymns.name: Gather the Clouds
hymns.text: Until your next turn, the Storm tone's stage effects count 1 stage higher for your side.

miracle.name: The Sky Answers
miracle.text: Pick a 5 × 5 area you can see. Every enemy in it takes 150 lightning damage × your Blessing power, is Stunned for 1 round and is Shaken. Your own side is never hit.

refused: Too small a voice for so large a sky!
taboo: RUNNING? From a little weather?
Hiding is for drizzle.
I saw that. The whole sky saw that.
vow_broken: You broke it like cheap pottery!
Thunder never breaks its word. Only you.
Disgraceful. Even the rain is embarrassed.
witnessed: ALL EYES ON YOU, SMALL ONE!
conversion: You are under my sky now.
My rival will hate this. Excellent.
farewell: LEAVE, THEN! THE SKY HAS OTHER FAVOURITES!
You'll hear from me. Everyone hears from me.
Go to my rival, then. I DARE you.
grant: {name}! YOU CALLED, AND THE SKY ANSWERS! I GRANT THEE THIS REQUEST!
HEAR ME, {name}! LET MY RIVAL WATCH AND WEEP!
{name}, SMALL ONE! STAND BACK AND BEHOLD!

items.name: The Matchmaker
items.domain: Love, bonds, the people you'd die for
items.costume: The love goddess, played as a wedding planner: a clipboard, a seating chart, and spools of red thread.

taboo_notes.kill: only the kill of a surrendered or Downed creature

grudge.text: The Matchmaker tells everyone about the break-up: you start every fight Weakened, with no heart for it.

accord_terms: Answers anyone in love, or anyone who should be
Never breaks a bond she tied
Plans everything

rites.name: Tie a Thread
rites.text: Tie a red thread on a friend's wrist. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, outside a fight: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Bring Two Together
rites.text: Reconcile two people who are at odds. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When an ally next to you is hit, half the damage moves to you.

hymns.name: Red Thread
hymns.text: Links two allies you can see for 2 rounds. When either one is hit, half the damage moves to the other.

hymns.name: Sweet Nothings
hymns.text: An enemy you can see must pass a Heart save or be Smitten for 1 round: it can't attack you, or any ally linked to you by Red Thread.

hymns.name: Together
hymns.text: Two allies standing next to each other each get +2 to hit and +2 Defense until your next turn.

miracle.name: Love Conquers
miracle.text: Every enemy in sight that is not a boss surrenders, with no save. A boss, or any enemy that can't surrender, must pass a Heart save or be Commanded to hold for 1 round: it makes no attacks.

refused: Not on the seating chart, sorry.
That is NOT in the plan.
taboo: You did NOT just hit your own date.
They had already said yes. To surrender.
I am crossing you off the guest list.
vow_kept: Promises kept are my favourite kind.
You kept it. I'm going to cry.
vow_broken: You broke a promise. In front of the guests?
witnessed: All eyes on the happy couple!
miracle: Everyone, put down your weapons and hug.
conversion: A new name on my guest list.
farewell: It's not you, darling. It's definitely you.
I'll keep your seat warm. For a while.
Fine. But I'm keeping the gifts.
grant: {name}, DARLING! I'VE CHECKED THE SEATING CHART. YOU'RE AT THE TOP TABLE.
OH, {name}. YOU ASKED WITH YOUR WHOLE HEART. YES. A THOUSAND TIMES, YES.
{name}! SAY NO MORE, DARLING. EVERYONE'S INVITED.

items.name: The Counting Weaver
items.domain: Fate, the count, what is owed
items.costume: The fate-spinner, played as an auditor: a loom of ledger tape and an abacus of beads that clicks while she listens.

grudge.text: The Weaver keeps a knot of your thread: you start every fight Pinned.

accord_terms: Answers anyone who keeps an honest count
Never alters a thread already woven
Bills in arrears
tenets: Keep your place in the pattern

rites.name: Settle Accounts
rites.text: Read out every debt you owe. You can do it once a session, from the story screen, after you have rested this session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Repay a Debt
rites.text: Pay back what you owe someone, in full. The Narrator decides when you have done it. Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

intervention.text: When an enemy scores a critical hit on you, it becomes a normal hit.

hymns.name: Foreknowing
hymns.text: The next 4 attacks against you or an ally you can see miss.

hymns.name: Unravel
hymns.text: An enemy you can see loses every buff and its shield. It also stops being Braced and loses any shot it is holding.

hymns.name: Cut Short
hymns.text: An enemy you can see must pass a Heart save or be Stunned and lose its next turn. A boss loses 2 AP on its next turn instead, with no save. An enemy that Cut Short has just cost a turn can't be Cut Short again in the round after.

miracle.name: Rewoven
miracle.text: Every ally whose HP was higher at the start of this round gets that HP back, and the Downed among them stand up. Then the whole squad takes another full turn, right now.

taboo: Running is a debt, too.
Betrayal. Recorded. Permanently.
Your account is overdrawn.
witnessed: I am counting every move now.
intervention: An error in the ledger, corrected.
miracle: Once more from the last knot.
conversion: Your thread is in my loom now.
farewell: Account closed.
Your thread is cut loose. The knot stays.
Balance settled. Mostly.
grant: {name}. YOUR ACCOUNT IS IN GOOD STANDING. THE REQUEST IS GRANTED.
{name}. I HAVE COUNTED EVERY BEAD. THE THREAD ALLOWS IT.
ENTERED IN THE LEDGER, {name}: ONE MIRACLE, PAID IN FULL.
